## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Tests were added or updated before the behavior change.
- [ ] A fresh Ubuntu 24.04 / ROS 2 Jazzy build completed.
- [ ] colcon test-result --all --verbose reports zero failures.
- [ ] python3 tools/check_public_tree.py passes.
- [ ] git diff --check passes.
- [ ] User-facing documentation is updated.
- [ ] No bag, MCAP, image, recording, credential, or private data is included.
- [ ] Hardware evidence is attached only when this change makes a hardware claim.
